name: cha-design-system
description: City of Chattanooga design system: Storybook docs and visual regression tests, generated from the CHA Design System Figma file.

scripts.figma:sync: python3 scripts/figma_sync.py snapshot --metadata design-system/figma/metadata --variables design-system/tokens.figma.json --set-variables design-system/figma/variables --screens design-system/figma/screens --context design-system/figma/context --carry design-system/figma-snapshot.json --out design-system/figma-snapshot.new.json && python3 scripts/figma_sync.py diff design-system/figma-snapshot.json design-system/figma-snapshot.new.json --manifest design-system/manifest.json --out design-system/reports/figma-changes --apply || test $? -eq 2
scripts.figma:audit: python3 scripts/token_audit.py --context design-system/figma/context --variables design-system/tokens.figma.json --metadata design-system/figma/metadata --file-url https://www.figma.com/design/nMenOGxGYRL0pyDAc0ZmFF/CHA-Design-System--Copy- --manifest design-system/manifest.json --out design-system/reports/token-audit
